title: スプリンターズSの後に・金風に決戦を

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr runs fantastically at the Sprinters Stakes. After the race, she meets with Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having seen today's incredible race, Teio says that she feels motivated to fight on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both runners decide to compete in the autumn Tenno Sho—a race that neither of their revered Emperors managed to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, next year's race becomes Zephyr's ultimate goal. With that in mind…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We have to conquer both the sprint and mile tours first. That's why our next goal will be the Mile Championship.
